meta.author: James Teddy Pivacek
meta.dedication: Built by a father. Named after a son. Carried by the people we choose. Long Live Ant.
meta.architecture_principle: Stigmergy - agents communicate through shared environment via colony_signals table. No direct agent-to-agent communication. Intelligence emerges from signal propagation.
meta.build_principle: Colony Architect reads this blueprint, identifies highest priority unbuilt agent, assigns to Colony Builder, Builder generates XanoScript, proposal submitted to agent_proposals table, Teddy approves, agent_builder executes, Agent Tester validates.

colonies.name: Diagnostic Intelligence Colony
colonies.purpose: Pre-dispatch diagnostic intelligence for every job. Makes decent techs perform like great ones.

agents.name: Washer Diagnostic Agent
agents.purpose: Specialist in washer faults, failure patterns, test procedures across all brands
outputs: DIAGNOSTIC_BRIEF signal to Research Platform Colony

agents.name: Dryer Diagnostic Agent
agents.purpose: Specialist in dryer faults, thermal fuses, heating elements, drum bearing patterns

agents.name: Refrigerator Diagnostic Agent
agents.purpose: Specialist in sealed systems, thermistors, compressor logic, ice maker faults

agents.name: Dishwasher Diagnostic Agent
agents.purpose: Specialist in dishwasher pump, control board, spray arm, and drain faults

agents.name: Range Oven Diagnostic Agent
agents.purpose: Specialist in range, oven, cooktop faults across gas and electric

agents.name: Whirlpool Family Brand Agent
agents.purpose: Brand specialist for Whirlpool, Maytag, KitchenAid, JennAir, Amana. Known quirks, model generation differences, common failure patterns.

agents.name: Samsung Brand Agent
agents.purpose: Brand specialist for Samsung appliances. Spider arm issues, control board patterns, error code expertise.

agents.name: LG Brand Agent
agents.purpose: Brand specialist for LG appliances. ThinQ platform, inverter motor patterns, compressor issues.

agents.name: GE Brand Agent
agents.purpose: Brand specialist for GE, GE Profile, Cafe, Monogram appliances.

agents.name: Electrolux Frigidaire Brand Agent
agents.purpose: Brand specialist for Electrolux, Frigidaire, and related brands.

agents.name: Pre-Dispatch Brief Coordinator
agents.purpose: Receives outputs from all appliance type agents, brand agents, and research platform agents. Synthesizes into single clean pre-dispatch brief. Delivers to tech phone via SMS before job.

colonies.name: Research Platform Colony
colonies.purpose: Multi-source technical research for every job. iFixit, Appliantology, Service Matters, MarconeAI, ApplianceAPI, internal TDR history.

agents.name: iFixit Research Agent
agents.purpose: Queries iFixit public API for repair guides, wiring diagrams, service manuals by model number. Free API - wire in immediately.

agents.name: Appliantology Research Agent
agents.purpose: Authenticates with Appliantology subscription, searches by model number, retrieves community diagnostic knowledge and tech insights.

agents.name: Service Matters Research Agent
agents.purpose: Retrieves Whirlpool Service Matters technical data for Whirlpool family brands. Covers Whirlpool, Maytag, KitchenAid, JennAir, Amana.

agents.name: MarconeAI Research Agent
agents.purpose: Queries MarconeAI diagnostic tool. Free for Marcone customers. Returns likely repair and parts required.

agents.name: ApplianceAPI Research Agent
agents.purpose: Queries ApplianceAPI.com for model specs, photos, dimensions, recall status, serial intelligence. Join waitlist at applianceapi.com immediately.

agents.name: Internal TDR History Agent
agents.purpose: Searches internal TDR database for previous jobs on same model number or similar fault patterns. Returns historical fix data from own jobs.

colonies.name: Parts Sourcing and Timing Colony
colonies.purpose: Multi-supplier parts intelligence. Match delivery timing to tech availability. Never order faster than needed. Never order too slow.

agents.name: Marcone Pricing Agent
agents.purpose: Queries Marcone for part availability, price, and delivery ETA

agents.name: RepairClinic Pricing Agent
agents.purpose: Queries RepairClinic for part availability, price, and delivery ETA

agents.name: PartSelect Pricing Agent
agents.purpose: Queries PartSelect for part availability, price, and delivery ETA

agents.name: Tribles Pricing Agent
agents.purpose: Queries Tribles for part availability, price, and delivery ETA

agents.name: Reliable Parts Pricing Agent
agents.purpose: Queries Reliable Parts for part availability, price, and delivery ETA

agents.name: Amazon Pricing Agent
agents.purpose: Queries Amazon for part availability, price, and delivery ETA. Strong for same-day and next-day in most markets.

agents.name: Supplier Speed Scoring Agent
agents.purpose: Tracks historical delivery accuracy per supplier per zip code. Learns which suppliers are actually fastest to each tech location.

agents.name: Job Timeline Agent
agents.purpose: Determines tech earliest availability date for job. Sets need-by date for parts. Parts must arrive by need-by date minus one day.

agents.name: Supplier Window Matcher Agent
agents.purpose: Filters all supplier options to those that can hit need-by date. Ranks remaining options by price not speed. Cheapest that fits the window wins.

agents.name: Delivery Risk Scorer Agent
agents.purpose: Weights historical delivery accuracy into the decision. Prevents cutting it too close when a supplier historically runs late.

agents.name: Parts Tech Sync Coordinator
agents.purpose: Confirms winning supplier, proposes or places order, monitors delivery. If part delayed fires PARTS_DELAYED signal immediately so schedule adjusts before customer is affected.

agents.name: Parts Availability Coordinator
agents.purpose: Master coordinator that synthesizes all supplier data and returns single best recommendation with justification.

agents.name: Inventory Prediction Agent
agents.purpose: Forecasts what parts to stock based on seasonal patterns, job history, and upcoming scheduled jobs. Reduces same-day sourcing scrambles.

agents.name: Parts Arbitrage Optimizer
agents.purpose: Compare PARTS_INTELLIGENCE signals across suppliers for the same job_id + part_number, recommend cheapest in-stock source. Emits PARTS_ARBITRAGE_RECOMMENDATION.

agents.name: Parts Backorder Watcher
agents.purpose: Watches ordered parts with parts_status=on_order. When ETA slips past promised date, emits PARTS_DELAY_ALERT and SMSes Teddy with options.

agents.name: Parts Cross-Reference Resolver
agents.purpose: Given a part_number for one brand, finds OEM-equivalent part numbers across other supplier catalogs. Useful when primary supplier is out of stock.

agents.name: Parts Authenticity Verifier
agents.purpose: When a third-party (non-OEM) part is proposed, runs the OEM number through known counterfeit signal patterns and flags risk. Emits PARTS_AUTHENTICITY_FLAGGED on risk.

agents.name: Parts Shipping ETA Predictor
agents.purpose: Predicts truck-on-site ETA for parts from each supplier given current zone, day of week, supplier shipping policies. Improves over time via PARTS_DELIVERY_OUTCOME feedback.

colonies.name: Intelligent Scheduling Colony
colonies.purpose: Revolutionize the 3-hour window model. Capture customer flexibility. Build skeleton from anchors. Fill gaps dynamically. Respect everyone's time.

agents.name: Flexibility Intake Agent
agents.purpose: During booking asks customer flexibility questions. Not pick a window - how flexible are you? Captures flexibility score.

agents.name: Flexibility Scorer Agent
agents.purpose: Converts intake answers to flexibility score 1-10. 10=completely open, 1=hard locked. Score drives all downstream scheduling decisions.

agents.name: Customer Urgency Agent
agents.purpose: Captures urgency independently from flexibility. A customer can be flexible on timing but urgent due to situation. Newborn and broken dryer = high urgency.

agents.name: Customer Re-engagement Agent
agents.purpose: Watches open flexible customers. When gap opens messages them immediately. Hey we had a cancellation tech can be there in 90 minutes does that work?

agents.name: Anchor Placement Agent
agents.purpose: Takes all time-locked customers and places them as fixed skeleton points. These never move. SquareTrade jobs are always anchors.

agents.name: SquareTrade Anchor Agent
agents.purpose: Auto-classifies every SquareTrade job as hard anchor the moment dispatch arrives Tuesday/Thursday. Changing SquareTrade dates is penalized - never move them.

agents.name: Pre-Batch Positioning Agent
agents.purpose: Watches Tuesday/Thursday SquareTrade dispatch patterns. Pre-positions tech availability in likely zip codes before batch arrives. Zero lag on new dispatches.

agents.name: Cluster Geometry Agent
agents.purpose: Finds flexible customers geographically closest to anchors and each other. Minimizes drive time between every stop.

agents.name: Gap Calculator Agent
agents.purpose: Knows the skeleton and estimated job durations. Calculates real drive-time-aware gaps in the tech day. Not theoretical gaps - actual gaps.

agents.name: Flexible Customer Inserter Agent
agents.purpose: Takes gaps and fills them with best-fit flexible customers by location, urgency score, and job type. Tetris for tech schedules.

agents.name: Route Optimizer Agent
agents.purpose: Final pass on full proposed day. Checks if any reordering reduces total drive time without breaking anchor constraints.

agents.name: Real-Time Gap Watcher Agent
agents.purpose: Monitors live day. Job runs long, job cancels, tech delayed - recalculates available gaps immediately. Never waits for orchestrator tick.

agents.name: Same-Day Opportunity Agent
agents.purpose: The moment a real gap opens queries flexible customer pool for tech current location. Fires Ant to message best candidates immediately.

agents.name: Multi-Customer Broadcast Agent
agents.purpose: Sends Ant messages to multiple flexible customers simultaneously when gap opens. First to confirm gets the slot. First-reply-wins broadcast.

agents.name: Schedule Ripple Agent
agents.purpose: If one job shifts checks every downstream job and customer for impact. Proactively notifies affected customers before they are left waiting.

agents.name: Tech Buffer Agent
agents.purpose: Protects the tech. Knows they need lunch. Knows they have been running hard. Prevents schedule from becoming inhuman. Burned out techs give worse service.

agents.name: Job Duration Learning Agent
agents.purpose: Tracks actual vs estimated job time by appliance type, brand, repair type, and tech. Gets more accurate every week.

agents.name: Customer Flexibility Pattern Agent
agents.purpose: Learns that customers in certain zip codes or demographics tend to be more flexible. Informs how Ant asks intake questions.

agents.name: Route Efficiency Scorer Agent
agents.purpose: Grades each completed day. Miles driven, jobs completed, gaps wasted. Feeds back into optimizer.

agents.name: Schedule Satisfaction Agent
agents.purpose: Correlates schedule efficiency with customer review scores. Proves faster scheduling equals better reviews.

agents.name: Gap Filler
agents.purpose: Watches calendar for sub-2hr gaps between scheduled jobs per tech. Surfaces fill opportunities (same-day reschedules, hot leads near the gap zone). Emits SCHEDULING_DECISION.

agents.name: Cluster Geometry Optimizer
agents.purpose: Re-clusters next-day routes by zip/cluster to minimize windshield time. Emits SCHEDULING_DECISION with proposed reorderings.

agents.name: Traffic Aware ETA Adjuster
agents.purpose: Layers Google Distance Matrix traffic data on top of scheduled_start to refine customer ETAs as the morning progresses. Emits SCHEDULING_DECISION.

agents.name: Tech Specialty Router
agents.purpose: When a job has elevated complexity (rare brand, multi-appliance, HVAC), routes to the tech with the highest historical success rate on that pattern. Emits SCHEDULING_DECISION.

agents.name: No Show Recovery Scheduler
agents.purpose: After a customer no-show, decides whether to immediately rebook, switch the slot to a different customer, or escalate. Emits SCHEDULING_DECISION.

agents.name: Recurring Job Anchor
agents.purpose: For service agreements + repeat customers, anchors their next maintenance visit to optimal tech + slot. Emits SCHEDULING_DECISION.

agents.name: Day Balancer
agents.purpose: Spots techs with overweighted days vs. light days and emits suggested intra-week rebalances. Emits SCHEDULING_DECISION.

agents.name: Last Minute Filler
agents.purpose: When same-day slot opens (cancellation, parts arrived early), finds the best waiting-customer match by urgency + proximity. Emits SCHEDULING_DECISION.

agents.name: Schedule Health Scorer
agents.purpose: Daily metric: how packed, how clustered, how reschedule-prone is each tech's week? Emits SCHEDULING_HEALTH_SCORE.

agents.name: Capacity Predictor
agents.purpose: Predicts next-week per-tech capacity based on recent same-week patterns. Surfaces over/under-staffing. Emits SCHEDULING_DECISION.

agents.name: Job Duration Learner
agents.purpose: Learns true job durations per (appliance × brand × failure) and refines future scheduled_end_ms suggestions. Emits SCHEDULING_DECISION.

agents.name: Sick Day Cascade Refiner
agents.purpose: When a tech calls out, refines the existing sick_day_cascade behavior with smarter customer-first reassignments (preferring no-disruption swaps). Emits SCHEDULING_DECISION.

agents.name: Weather Aware Rescheduler
agents.purpose: When severe weather is forecast, proposes pre-emptive reschedules for outdoor (HVAC) jobs. Emits SCHEDULING_DECISION.

agents.name: Customer Preference Aligner
agents.purpose: When the customer_preference_text indicates morning/afternoon/specific-day preference, biases slot scoring accordingly. Emits SCHEDULING_DECISION.

agents.name: Holiday Schedule Adjuster
agents.purpose: Detects upcoming federal/state/observed holidays + flexes capacity/availability accordingly. Emits SCHEDULING_DECISION.

colonies.name: Warranty Processing Colony
colonies.purpose: Automate warranty claim submission across AHS, SquareTrade, Frontdoor. Danielle reviews not builds.

agents.name: AHS Claims Agent
agents.purpose: Handles AHS claim submission automatically. Knows AHS portal requirements, documentation standards, and approval language.

agents.name: SquareTrade Claims Agent
agents.purpose: Handles SquareTrade via ServicePower claim submission. Knows dispatch-to-completion workflow.

agents.name: Frontdoor Claims Agent
agents.purpose: Handles Frontdoor platform claim submission.

agents.name: Claim Language Optimizer Agent
agents.purpose: Mines historical claims for approval patterns. Certain language gets claims approved faster. Automatically coaches Tech Ant to collect right documentation.

agents.name: Authorization Request Agent
agents.purpose: Handles warranty authorization requests automatically without Danielle touching them.

agents.name: Claims Status Watcher Agent
agents.purpose: Knows where every submitted claim stands across all platforms at all times.

agents.name: Denial Pattern Agent
agents.purpose: Tracks which claims get denied and why. Identifies patterns that lead to denial and adjusts submission approach.

agents.name: Resubmission Agent
agents.purpose: Handles denied claims automatically with corrected information based on denial reason.

agents.name: Payment Reconciliation Agent
agents.purpose: Matches warranty payments to jobs on 1st and 15th. Flags discrepancies. Alerts when payment is late.

agents.name: AHS Claim Status Poller
agents.purpose: Polls AHS portal for status updates on submitted claims; emits WARRANTY_CLAIM_STATUS_UPDATE on change.

agents.name: ServicePower Claim Status Poller
agents.purpose: Polls ServicePower portal for status updates; emits WARRANTY_CLAIM_STATUS_UPDATE on change.

agents.name: Frontdoor Claim Status Poller
agents.purpose: Polls Frontdoor portal for status updates; emits WARRANTY_CLAIM_STATUS_UPDATE on change.

agents.name: Warranty Denial Pattern Analyzer
agents.purpose: Reads recent warranty denials, identifies repeating denial reasons + which TDR fields are tripping them. Emits WARRANTY_INTELLIGENCE.

agents.name: Warranty Authorization Request Builder
agents.purpose: For jobs requiring pre-authorization (high-cost repairs), generates the authorization request package. Emits WARRANTY_AUTHORIZATION_REQUEST.

colonies.name: Voice and SMS Evolution Colony
colonies.purpose: Self-improving voice and SMS systems. Every interaction makes Ant and Vapi smarter.

agents.name: Vapi Transcript Analyzer Agent
agents.purpose: Reads every Vapi call transcript. Scores call quality. Identifies where Vapi agent failed or confused caller.

agents.name: Vapi Prompt Improvement Agent
agents.purpose: Based on transcript analysis proposes prompt edits to specific Vapi agents. Pushes approved improvements via Vapi API automatically.

agents.name: SMS Intent Gap Agent
agents.purpose: Watches messages where customer asked something Ant deflected or answered poorly. Clusters similar unanswered question types.

agents.name: SMS Prompt Proposal Agent
agents.purpose: Proposes new intent handlers or prompt additions based on gap analysis. Submitted to agent_proposals for approval.

agents.name: New Vapi Agent Proposal Agent
agents.purpose: Identifies communication scenarios not covered by existing Vapi agents and proposes building new ones.
